summary: Central Puerto S.A., an Argentine electric services foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting an open-market share repurchase under Argentina's Capital Markets Law. On September 3, 2026, the company bought 120,000 book-entry common shares (ARS 1 par, one vote each) on BYMA at an average price of ARS 2,241.73 per share, for a total cash outlay of ARS 269,008,131 (approximately USD 0.2M assuming ~ARS 1,300/USD). Settlement occurred September 4, 2026. Daily purchases did not exceed 25% of the prior 90-day average daily trading volume, complying with Argentine regulatory limits. This is a routine buyback disclosure outside the US; no tender offer, premium, or board advisor details were provided. Watch for continued repurchase cadence and potential support to share price.
